name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: Elling Trias sends you south from Stormwind to seek news of the missing diplomat. His lead points toward Duskwood and Watcher Backus, a contact near Darkshire who may know of Defias activity.

sections.title: Footwork in the Gloom
sections.body: After a frustrating exchange with Jorgen, Elling Trias, the cheesemonger, turns to his wider circle of informants. To save his own coin, he sends you to do the fieldwork instead of hiring agents. You carry a sealed missive across the border into Duskwood, where beasts and the undead make travel dangerous.

sections.title: A Friendly Ear in the Night Watch
sections.body: Watcher Backus patrols the northern approach to Darkshire as a member of the Night Watch. Trias trusts him to report illicit movements through Duskwood. Show Backus the sealed dispatch, and he can share guard records and local gossip about Defias Brotherhood operations in the south.

faq.q: Why is Elling Trias sending me to Duskwood?
faq.answer: Elling Trias is following leads on the missing diplomat and suspected Defias Brotherhood activity. To use his contacts without spending coin on agents, he sends you to ask Watcher Backus what is happening in Duskwood.

faq.q: Where can I find Watcher Backus?
faq.answer: Watcher Backus patrols the northern dirt road just outside Darkshire in Duskwood, along the road toward Redridge and Elwynn Forest.
Watcher Backus is a soldier in Darkshire's civic militia, the Night Watch. He knows Elling Trias personally and shares what he sees of suspicious travelers and criminal movements.

faq.q: What is in the sealed note given to Backus?
faq.answer: Elling Trias's sealed note asks Watcher Backus for intelligence about local sightings or movements of the Defias Brotherhood through Duskwood.

faq.q: What does Duskwood have to do with the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood is centered in Westfall and hides beneath the Deadmines. Its cells, couriers, and hideouts also reach through the southern human provinces, including Duskwood's shadowed fringes.

faq.q: Why does Trias complain about Jorgen?
faq.answer: Jorgen stonewalled Trias or drove a hard bargain during the investigation. Trias was so irritated that he cursed Jorgen to the Twisting Nether before turning to other contacts in the field.

angles.text: As an Alliance hero, you help pursue a disappearance that concerns Stormwind's royal interests. The search brings together royal spymasters, independent crooks, and regional militias.
As a rogue, you see how Elling Trias works through a network. He relies on independent foot soldiers to gather information while keeping his own hands clean.
